# make_bg_image { #mofography.visualize.make_bg_image }

```python
visualize.make_bg_image(type='radial', cmap='plasma_r')
```

It takes a 2D array and a colormap and returns a plotly image object that can be used as a
background image

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                                               | Default      |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------|
| type   |        | 'radial', 'left_to_right', 'bottom_to_top', defaults to radial (optional) | `'radial'`   |
| cmap   |        | The colormap to use, defaults to plasma_r (optional)                      | `'plasma_r'` |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description           |
|--------|--------|-----------------------|
|        |        | A plotly image object |
